leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the case at the bench was a predictable preparation with little to discover in its result.

surprise.text: Nothing in this chapter particularly surprised me; the listed actions followed the expected transfer sequence.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although I could not tell whether the order of bringing the case and carrier to the bench mattered.

continue.text: I would continue to see the discovery reach Earth and learn what researchers make of it, though this chapter's actions were mostly straightforward logistics.
